mapper.select: SELECT homework_no , class_id , homework_title , homework_rdate , homework_ddate , (select count(t.homework_no) from test t join homework h on(t.homework_no = h.homework_no)) as problem_count , ((select count(submit_test_no) from submit_test s join homework h on(s.homework_no = h.homework_no) where answer_state = (select sub_cd_nm from sub_cd where sub_cd = 'C301')) || '/' || (SELECT count(student_no) FROM student_manage s join homework h on(s.class_id = h.class_id))) as submit_count , FIND_CODENAME(homework_status) as homework_status , FIND_CODENAME(test_subject) as test_subject FROM homework ORDER BY homework_no

SELECT w.homework_no , homework_title , homework_rdate , homework_ddate , (select count(t.homework_no) from test t join homework h on(t.homework_no = h.homework_no))problem_count , answer_state , total_score , test_subject , class_id FROM homework w LEFT OUTER JOIN submit_test s ON (s.homework_no = w.homework_no and member_id = #{memberId}) WHERE test_subject = #{testSubject} AND class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY homework_no

SELECT homework_no , class_id , homework_title , homework_rdate , homework_ddate , (select count(t.homework_no) from test t join homework h on(t.homework_no = h.homework_no)) as problem_count , ((select count(submit_test_no) from submit_test s join homework h on(s.homework_no = h.homework_no) where answer_state = (select sub_cd_nm from sub_cd where sub_cd = 'C301')) || '/' || (SELECT count(student_no) FROM student_manage s join homework h on(s.class_id = h.class_id))) as submit_count , FIND_CODENAME(homework_status) as homework_status , test_subject FROM homework WHERE homework_no = #{homeworkNo}
